exposure: H2O2-induced oxidative stress (100 microM H2O2 for 24 hours)
outcome: mRNA expression levels of superoxide dismutase 1 (SOD1)
mRNA expression levels of hypoxia-inducible factor 1alpha (HIF1alpha)
cohort: Mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) isolated from Wharton's jelly of human umbilical cord tissue were used for in vitro experimentation.
finding: MSC preconditioning with combined hypoxia and LPS significantly enhanced cell viability, shortened population doubling time, and increased resistance to H2O2-induced oxidative stress.
